hero.headline: Excellence for Africa's Digital Gateway
hero.subheadline: We hold our local partners to the highest international standards to ensure the success of this 1MW infrastructure asset.

sections.title: The Standards of a Global AI Hub
sections.body: To build a facility that competes with the best in the world, our local Kenyan partners must demonstrate a commitment to operational excellence and technical precision. We are looking for established entities in the energy and construction sectors that have a proven track record of delivering multi-million dollar industrial projects on time and within budget. Our requirements go beyond simple financing; we seek partners who can navigate the local regulatory landscape with integrity, manage a skilled technical workforce, and maintain the complex systems of a 24/7 data center. In return, we offer a world-class technology transfer, international currency revenue, and a seat at the table of the most innovative infrastructure project in East Africa. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.

sections.title: Criteria for Kenyan Partners
items: Energy Capacity: Proven ability to build and operate 2MW+ hybrid generation plants.
Financial Health: Audited financial statements and clear proof of capital for local CAPEX share.
Regulatory Record: Clean history of compliance with Kenyan licensing and environmental laws.
Human Capital: Access to certified mechanical and electrical engineers (Certs: KETRACO/EPRA).
Commitment: Long-term vision for scaling from 1MW to 3MW+ over the next 5 years.
